CRIME IN INDIA - 1999 6.3.4 From the above table it is apparent that the incidence of Child Rape decreased in 1999 by 24.1 percent over 1998 and by 22.5 per cent compared to 1995. The incidence of `Buying of Girls for Prostitution', `Infanticide', `Foeticide' and `Abetment of Suicide' reported decline of 61.5%, 23.7%, 1.6% and 14.3% during the year over the previous year while incidence of `Kidnapping & Abduction of Children', `Selling of Girls for Prostitution', `Exposure and Abandonment' and `Child Marriage Restraint Act' showed increase over the previous year.
